sentinel_policy: Required axes may use explicit sentinel values when a dimension is not applicable or not yet specified; blank axes are release errors.

families.tax_administration_access: Filing, refund, payment, notice, correction, appeal, taxpayer service, and private-rail access routes.
families.cross_border_reporting: International information reporting, withholding, treaty, apportionment, tariff, and cross-border coordination routes.
families.controller_ai: AI controller, model-assisted administration, artificial personhood, and public-input reciprocity routes.
families.public_finance_core: General tax-design grammar, rate/base/proceeds, scorecard, review, and fiscal transparency routes.
families.wealth_property_rent: Land, housing, wealth, inheritance, rent, landlord/tenant, and property-location routes.
families.labor_care_benefits: Labor, platform work, care, family, retirement, long-term care, education, and worker-benefit routes.
families.environment_climate_commons: Climate, environmental justice, water, oceans, critical minerals, resource, transportation, and ecological commons routes.
families.financial_system_risk: Financial guarantees, insurance, pensions, digital assets, creditors, systemic risk, and market-contract routes.
families.legal_enforcement_penalty: Penalties, sanctions, courts, forfeiture, supervision, enforcement, whistleblower, and misconduct routes.
families.public_procurement_industrial_policy: Procurement, subsidies, public research, industrial policy, defense, stockpiles, and public-upside routes.
families.regulated_networks_platforms: Telecom, spectrum, digital gatekeepers, app stores, cloud, payment networks, ad markets, and other bottleneck-network routes.
families.release_integrity_currentness: Archive release integrity, source-currentness, cube lifecycle, and regression-harness routes.
families.social_floor_public_services: Agriculture, food, health, disability, immigration/asylum, public health, municipal finance, tribal sovereignty, and essential services routes.

source_currentness_policy: source_currentness_refs mark volatile legal/operational/data-projection anchors and require source_currentness_claims; broad source citations must not be promoted to currentness refs.
remedy_profile_policy: Every route record must have one remedy profile in docs/00-meta/remedy-profiles.json; remedy labels must state default move, blocked move, guardrails, escalation trigger, source-currentness linkage, and proceeds-integrity posture.
case_contract_policy: Every golden case must have a case contract with expected routes, route-backed flags, valid raw axes, remedy-profile obligations, sources, and must-not answers.

policy_action_profile_policy.reason: The instrument axis records labels; policy-action profiles classify the institutional move and block tax/fee/mandate/no-go category mistakes.

actor_accountability_profile_policy.reason: Subject and incidence axes do not identify who must act. Actor-accountability profiles distinguish primary accountable actor, secondary actors, burden bearers, beneficiaries, bottlenecks, non-responsible conduits, public fallback duties, and evidence requirements.
